## Setup

Loading data, packages, and models.

```{r}
# packages
library(whereipm)
library(tidyverse)

# data
data <- ipmdata %>%
  filter(sex == "F", habitat == "P")

# models
singleVRModels <- readRDS(file.path(here::here(), "results", "singleVRModels.rds"))
```

## Parameters and initial Population

Here we define kernel parameters and initial population size.

```{r}
# kernel parameters
kp <- create.kernel.params(L=-500, U=500, n.bins = 1000)
# initial population size
pop0 <- c(rep(0, kp$n.bins/2-2), rep(5,3), rep(0, kp$n.bins/2-1))
```

I am now calculating time specific parameter from the single models ran in the [Single VR Model](DIPM-040_Single_vr_model.html) vignette.

As opposed to what done previously (see [IPM Phases](DIPM-030_IPM_Phases.html)), now time specific paramters are not stored in different models, but need to be calculated one by one from the single model by plugging in picked values of time. So the parameter storing is made a little more complicated.

```{r, results = "asis"}
# First I need to extract the info in the model to make it easier to handle
Models <- singleVRModels %>%
  transmute(
    survival = map(survival, broom::tidy),
    recruit = map(recruitment, broom.mixed::tidy),
    adDispersal = map(adDispersal, broom::tidy),
    adDistance = map(adDistance, broom::tidy),
    natDispersal = map(natDispersal, broom::tidy),
    natDistance = map(natDistance, broom::tidy))

# Storing values into 3 vital params lists, at different time points (start, mid, end)
# given local density is scaled (but not centered) the estimates for the slope have to be transformed back to the non-scaled value.

# Using a general loop to do so for the three phases:

pickedTimes <- c(0, 30, 60)
for(i in pickedTimes){

  temp.vp <- list(# Survival
                 s.int = (Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate)) + # true intercept
                   returnIfExists(Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "s_time") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), # time intercept
                 s.slo = (Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale + # true slope
                   returnIfExists(Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "s_time:s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/(scalingAttr$time$scale*scalingAttr$loc_density$scale)), # time contribution,
                 s.slo2 = returnIfExists(Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "I(s_loc_density^2)") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale + # quadratic effect
                   returnIfExists(Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "s_time:I(s_loc_density^2)") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/(scalingAttr$loc_density$scale*scalingAttr$time$scale)),
                 s.multiplier = 1,
                 
                # Recruitment
                 r.int = Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "zi",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) + # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "zi",
                          term == "s_time") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), # time intercept 
                 r.slo = (Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "zi",
                          term == "s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale + # true slope
                  returnIfExists(Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "zi",
                          term == "s_time:s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/(scalingAttr$loc_density$scale*scalingAttr$time$scale)), # time interaction
                 r.multiplier = 1,
                
                 f.int = Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "cond",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) +                        # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "cond",
                          term == "s_time") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), # time intercept
                 f.slo = (Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "cond",
                          term == "s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale + # true slope
                  returnIfExists(Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "cond",
                          term == "s_time:s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/(scalingAttr$time$scale*scalingAttr$loc_density$scale)), # time interaction
                 f.distribution = 'ztpoisson',
                 
                # Adult dispersal
                 p.stat.int.ad = Models$adDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) + # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$adDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_time") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), # time intercept
                 p.stat.slo.ad = (Models$adDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale + # true slope
                  returnIfExists(Models$adDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_time:s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/(scalingAttr$loc_density$scale*scalingAttr$time$scale)), # time interaction
                 sigma.stat.ad = 0.25, 
                 mu.mob.int.ad = Models$adDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) + # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$adDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_time") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), #time intercept
                 mu.mob.slo.ad = returnIfExists(Models$adDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                 sigma.mob.ad = Models$adDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "ran_pars") %>%
                   pull(estimate) %>%
                   sum %>%
                   sqrt,
                 
                # Natal dispersal
                 p.stat.int.nat = Models$natDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) +                       # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$natDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_time.birth") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale),   # time intercept
                 p.stat.slo.nat = (Models$natDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                 p.stat.sloLand.nat = returnIfExists(Models$natDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_land_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$land_density$scale,
                 p.stat.sloInt.nat = returnIfExists(Models$natDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density.mid:s_land_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/(scalingAttr$loc_density$scale*scalingAttr$land_density$scale),
                 sigma.stat.nat = 0.25, 
                 mu.mob.int.nat = Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) +                           # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_time.birth") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), # time intercept
                 mu.mob.slo.nat = returnIfExists(Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                 mu.mob.sloLand.nat = returnIfExists(Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_land_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$land_density$scale,
                 mu.mob.sloInt.nat = returnIfExists(Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density.mid:s_land_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/(scalingAttr$loc_density$scale*scalingAttr$land_density$scale),
                 sigma.mob.nat = Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "ran_pars") %>%
                   pull(estimate) %>%
                   sum %>%
                   sqrt)
 
  ### there should be no empty values. let's check
  stopifnot(all(lapply(temp.vp, function(x)length(x)==0)==FALSE))
  
  # renaming list
  assign(paste("vp.t", i, sep = ""), temp.vp)
}

# visualising values
tab <- tibble("parameters" = names(vp.t0),
                  "t=0" = as.numeric(unlist(vp.t0)),
                  "t=30" = as.numeric(unlist(vp.t30)),
                  "t=60" = as.numeric(unlist(vp.t60)))
knitr::kable(tab, digits = 2, col.names = c("Parameters", "Early", "Mid", "Late"), caption = "Comparison of vital rates among time points")
```

## Running IPMs

Here I use the paramteres just extracted to run the models at beginning, mid and end.

```{r}
# running IPM
start <- Sys.time()
IPM.init <- runIPM(kp, vp.t0, init.pop = pop0, niter=36)
init.t <- Sys.time() - start
print(init.t)

start <- Sys.time()
IPM.middle <- runIPM(kp, vp.t30, init.pop = pop0, niter=36)
middle.t <- Sys.time() - start
print(middle.t)

start <- Sys.time()
IPM.end <- runIPM(kp, vp.t60, init.pop = pop0, niter=36)
end.t <- Sys.time() - start
print(end.t)
```

And plot the results.
For details on the edits on plot_ly see [link](https://plot.ly/r/contour-plots/).

```{r}
plotly::plot_ly(x=1:ncol(IPM.init$pop.size), 
                y=rev(kp$y), 
                z=IPM.init$pop.size, 
                type="contour", colorscale = 'Jet',
                autocontour = F,
                contours = list(start = 0, 
                                end = 28,
                                size = 2))
plotly::plot_ly(x=1:ncol(IPM.middle$pop.size),
                y=rev(kp$y),
                z=IPM.middle$pop.size,
                type="contour", colorscale = 'Jet',
                autocontour = F,
                contours = list(start = 0, 
                                end = 28,
                                size = 2))
plotly::plot_ly(x=1:ncol(IPM.end$pop.size),
                y=rev(kp$y),
                z=IPM.end$pop.size,
                type="contour", colorscale = 'Jet',
                autocontour = F,
                contours = list(start = 0, 
                                end = 28,
                                size = 2))

quick.plot(IPM.init, "Init")
quick.plot(IPM.middle, "Middle")
quick.plot(IPM.end, "End")
```

## Storing models
